description: Every task and scheduled job across your teams, live in one place.
emptyHint: Team tasks and scheduled jobs appear here the moment they start.

cost.noData: No spend recorded for this period.
cost.emptyHint: Costs appear here as your agents run turns across backends. Pick a longer period to widen the window.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.deleteBody: This budget and its limit will be removed. Spend history is unaffected.
budgets.emptyHint: Set a spend limit per model, backend, team, or globally. Budgets warn by default; pause is opt-in and resumable.
budgets.pauseHint: Pausing is opt-in and resumable: turns are gated only while over budget, and you can resume from the alert.
budgets.pauseActionHint: Pause gates new turns for this scope while over budget. It is resumable at any time and reserved for scheduled or team work.

fx.title: Exchange rate
fx.unknown: No rate known - showing dollars only
fx.manualHint: A rate you enter here overrides the fetched one. Leave it empty to go back to the fetched rate.

goals.readOnlyNote: Read-only. This view shows what the engine reports about its long-running goals; opening, advancing and cancelling one are engine-side in this build.
goals.emptyHint: A goal appears here the moment the engine publishes one. The engine keeps them in its own journal, so a goal opened earlier shows up at its next update rather than right now.
goals.emptyHintUnavailable: This engine build does not report durable goals, so nothing will appear here until that changes.
goals.limitedTitle: Durable goals are limited in this engine build

gradeExplained.publication_bound: The shape is settled, but this build publishes these events only when it is configured to, so a goal may never be reported here.
gradeExplained.shape_only: The event type exists in this build but the behaviour behind it does not yet, so no goal will be reported.
gradeExplained.unavailable: This build does not carry durable goals at all.
gradeExplained.unrecognised: This host does not know that grade, so it cannot say what it means for you - the engine's own word for it is above.

goals.refusedTitle: The engine refused a control command
goals.refusedMismatch: This request id was sent for a different goal or session, so the refusal cannot be matched to a command this goal sent.
goals.lockedTitle: Control is locked until a resync
goals.lockedBody: The position this host holds is no longer one the engine accepts, so advancing or cancelling is refused until the engine republishes the goal.
goals.noTasks: The engine reported no tasks for this goal.
goals.tasksTruncated: The engine reported more tasks than are kept; the list above is cut short.
goals.dependsOnTruncated: A task listed more dependencies than are kept; the list above is cut short.
goals.textClamped: The engine sent text longer than is kept; what is shown is cut short.
goals.evicted: Older goals were dropped to keep this list bounded.
